summary: The engine in src/engine/evaluate.ts already existed and was correct against the pinned HealthRecord contract, so I left it unchanged. I added one test to test/engine/evaluate.test.ts, and `node --test test/engine/*.test.ts` passes 6 of 6. The two earlier acceptance failures are most likely in src/report/report.ts, which is outside my write scope. I did not change or run anything there.
remaining_uncertainty: The hidden checks for AC-SCHEMA-SUPPLY and AC-SLA-QUALITY probably depend on report output (an alert `detail` field, and the dash for an unmeasured dataset). I could not touch the report, so I cannot confirm they now pass.
If the hidden schema check expects drift fields in a different order than missing-first-then-unexpected, that would be an engine-side mismatch. I cannot see it.

questions.question: Should alertPayloads expose a `detail` field for schema_drift alerts, and should the SLA report render something other than 'n/a' for unmeasured datasets? The earlier acceptance failures point at both.
